 SCHLEICHER, TOM GREEN, AND                            §
 WILLIAMSON COUNTIES

     STIPULATION BETWEEN THE APPLICANTS AND THE MOSELY GROUP IN
           PLACE OF THE MOSELEY GROUP’S CROSS-EXAMINATION


         Intervenors James Gregory Waller, Marilyn Moseley Waller, Arthur Kyle Moseley, and

David Moseley (Moseley Group) and the Applicants stipulate as follows.

    1. Moseley Exhibit 3 (Cross) is a true and correct copy of the Map of the San Saba and

         Llano River watersheds issued by the Lower Colorado River Authority (LCRA). It is one

         of several watershed maps available on the LCRA web site.

    2. LCRA is a governmental entity.

    3. Moseley Exhibit 3 (Cross) was issued by LCRA as part of its activities.

    4. LCRA uses Moseley Exhibit 3 (Cross) and other watershed maps in its management of

         the lower Colorado River and through which LCRA provides a clean and reliable water

         supply and produces power. LCRA also makes its watershed maps available for use by

         other governmental agencies and the public.

    5. The applicants do not oppose Moseley Exhibit 3 (cross) being received into evidence.

                                             Stipulated and Agreed,

                                             By: /s/James E. Smith
